key.name: picture
key.description: "hearth", the image that follows the colour scheme, or an absolute path to an image. A path that is not a regular file shows the hearth.

key.name: per-output
key.description: Connector name to "hearth" or an absolute path. An output not listed shows "picture". Ignored while "same-on-all" is true.

key.name: same-on-all
key.description: True: every output shows "picture" and "per-output" is ignored.

key.name: migrated
key.summary: The one-time migration from cosmic-bg has run
key.description: Set by athanor-wallpaper after it copies com.system76.CosmicBackground (SD16). Nothing is copied again once it is true.
